name: SaaSBoard

sources.title: Homepage — live visual grid directory (692 live listings, 9,242 tiles available) with pricing and how-it-works sections

requirements: Any startup, website, or app — no stated niche restriction
A single 1×1 tile is free, no card required; larger blocks (2×2+) cost $10/tile/month or $100/tile/year via Stripe
Sign-in required to claim tiles and manage the listing (dashboard)
preparation: Logo image (uploaded; displayed on the grid)
Startup name, short description, and destination URL
Category pick for the listings index
Account to access the dashboard (sign-in link at /auth)
workflow: Click-and-drag on the 100×100 grid to select position and size — a single 1×1 tile is free
Upload the logo and enter name, description, and destination URL
Confirm — free tile locks on instantly; larger blocks go through Stripe checkout
Manage listing, edit details, and view click analytics in the dashboard
watchFor: The free route is only a 1×1 tile — tiny visual footprint; anything larger is paid
Grid placement is permanent position-wise but larger blocks require an active subscription — canceling likely removes the block
Million-dollar-homepage style gimmick; traffic is modest (claims 700+ daily visitors, 8,543 total clicks)
Free Discord promotion offered for listed startups
countsAsLive: The startup's logo tile is visible and clickable on the saasboard.app grid and appears in the 'Startups listed' index
unknowns: What happens to paid blocks on cancellation (removed vs shrunk to 1×1) — FAQ question exists but answer text did not render
Whether free tiles can be reclaimed/repositioned
